entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'd like to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Could you please provide your name and order number so I can pull up your account?
Sure, the name is Anya Sharma, order number VF7781-PULSE.
Thank you, Anya. I see your account here. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand Pulse? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, it works perfectly fine. To be honest, I just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and I've found I just don't use it enough to justify keeping it.
I appreciate the honesty. It happens to the best of us. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it was delivered on December 19th, which was 18 days ago.

Anya, for our VeloBand Pulse specifically, because it's a device that activates and links to a user's health data, we have a strict 10-day return window for preference-based returns. I'm afraid at 18 days, it's outside of that policy.

I see. 10 days is a very short window. I understand policies are in place for a reason, but I've been a VIP member with VeloFit for years. Is there any flexibility here? Perhaps a partial store credit or even a discount code for my next purchase?

I completely understand your position, and we truly value your loyalty as a VIP member. While I'm unable to process a return or offer credit for the band itself due to the policy, I do have an excellent alternative that might be perfect for you.

We have an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a community platform where members can sell their gently used gear to other cyclists. It's a great way to ensure the device gets used and you can recover most of your cost.
A resale platform... I'm listening. Is it difficult to use? And does VeloFit take a big commission on the sale?

It's very user-friendly. You get to set your own price. And here's something I can do for you: as a thank you for being a VIP member, I can go ahead and waive the standard listing fee for this item. That way, the full amount of the sale goes directly to you.
You can waive the fee entirely? Okay, that's actually a very fair solution. I like that. It's better than it collecting dust here. Yes, I'd like to do that. How do I get started?

Excellent. I've just applied a one-time fee waiver to your account for a VeloBand Pulse listing. I'm also sending an email to you right now with a direct link and a simple guide to get your post up. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Anya?
No, that's everything. I appreciate you finding a good workaround for me, Isaac. Thank you.
You're very welcome. It was my pleasure to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful rest of your day.
